result.brief: 提出双工流式多模态模型，将视频、音频与文本输出对齐到共享时间网格，实现输入输出同步推进的低延迟实时生成。
result.reason: Duplex streaming multimodal model aligning video, audio, and text on a shared temporal grid with slot-level autoregressive generation; directly enables realtime audio-video aligned generation and streaming video modeling.
